context: Original BALA v1.314 taxon response has already been exposed. Original one-shot v1.314 score remains SEALED and must not be rerun. v1.316 is a separately declared falsification/sensitivity, NOT new independent source or pristine confirmatory test.
ecological_question: Does the observed same-transect B1→B3 species-composition dissimilarity exceed the spurious apparent turnover obtained from two disjoint matched-effort sub-samples WITHIN each original campaign, where the underlying site/period was nominally the same?

sampling.source_site_unit: original BALA 29 physically identical native-forest transects on seven islands, never individual traps or Event rows
sampling.equal_EVent_rule: Reconstruct previously fixed 29 source site×2 method×3 phase ORIGINAL 4620 selected Event IDs and their source sha, NEVER select new sites or change method/phase
sampling.site_phase_halving: For each original site×method×phase, original chosen k Event IDs sorted by SHA256(salt+source-original-coreid), split first floor(k/2) and second floor(k/2) into two disjoint half-effort samples; if odd k one last Event omitted in that split. No species content used for partitioning.
sampling.zero_detected_half_policy: A pair with either empty detected guild taxon set is not estimated; a site×guild participates only if all four halves B1A/B1B/B3A/B3B are nonempty for at least five of nine predefined splits. Report all missing splits and sites, do not convert zero detections to dissimilarity zero.
sampling.allowed_source_name: Original strict source taxonRank species, subspecies or morphospecies, scientificName casefold/whitespace normalized, guild source order exactly spiders or beetles; no synonyms or alternative morphology selected after outcomes

metrics.within_campaign_control: Per split/site/guild, Sørensen (and Simpson replacement) between B1A and B1B and between B3A and B3B, then average both; this is a same-period apparent-composition-difference benchmark under matched source trap count.
metrics.across_campaign: Per split/site/guild, calculate the four dissimilarities B1A–B3A, B1A–B3B, B1B–B3A, B1B–B3B; average four. Every compared half contains exactly floor(k/2) source Events.
metrics.delta: Across-campaign Sørensen mean minus within-campaign Sørensen mean, per site/guild and split; also Simpson replacement analogue. Positive indicates taxon-detection composition differs across distant periods more than the source's own within-period sampling heterogeneity.
metrics.aggregation: Average valid split deltas within each original physical transect, average across sites within each original seven islands, then equal island weighting. Report island sample n, 9-split variation envelope, number of positive source islands, source site fraction passing all predetermined gates; no independent-replicate statistics from split seeds.
metrics.secondary: Beating method source-only same criterion; run only as prespecified separate descriptive quality context. No origin-class thresholds or post hoc taxon subgroups.
metrics.inferential_threshold: Scientific direction positive when mean delta >0; no p-value or claim of ecological confidence interval; if qualifying islands less than 5 OR qualifying physical site comparisons <20 per guild, STOP that guild with no main ecological score. Never adjust thresholds after original response.

falsification.null_hypothesis: Species composition apparent change B1→B3 can be explained by within-phase sampling/detection variability under equivalent capture opportunities; delta approximately zero or negative.
falsification.alternative: Between-campaign dissimilarity exceeds within-campaign sampling-only pseudo-turnover, delta positive consistently across original islands. Still not true extinction/colonization: taxonomic drift, phenology, different years or environmental conditions remain confounds.
falsification.caveat: Within-phase split trap records are neither independent species occupancy replicates nor an explicit occupancy-detection model. They measure within-campaign sample heterogeneity and can have spatial microstructure; nine salts are pseudoreplicated sensitivity resamples, not 9 biological experiments.

nonclaims: No genuinely new independent data; same original BALA response was read in v1.314
No true species extinction/colonization or inter-island rescue
No causal homogenization, climate driver or invasion mechanism
No detection-corrected multi-season occupancy probability inference
